description: This file is a C header file that declares exported API functions related to an HTTP message parser component. It includes licensing information, a module description, and function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the parser component.

methods.name: AnscCreateHttpMPComponent
methods.description: Creates and initializes an HTTP message parser component with specified context handles.

methods.name: AnscHttpMPCOCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the HTTP message parser component with specified context handles.

methods.name: AnscHttpMPCORemove
methods.description: Removes or deinitializes the HTTP message parser component instance.

methods.name: AnscHttpMPCOEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers objects required by the HTTP message parser component.

methods.name: AnscHttpMPCOInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP message parser component instance.
